title: Why does ice float on water?

shots.intent: Open directly on the transparent tank and ice. No humanoid is present because the phenomenon itself is the subject.

shots.beat: Ice drops, splashes, and refuses to sink
shots.intent: Follow the cube into the water and hold the waterline clearly enough that the surprising floating state reads without a witness character.

effects.purpose: Makes the water contact readable at phone size.

shots.intent: Orbit the ice as it expands conceptually; the transformation, not a character reaction, carries the explanation.

effects.purpose: Suggests the more open frozen structure without cluttering the tank.

shots.intent: Show the cube rise and begin a subtle bob while the water-to-ice relationship visualizes lower density.

effects.purpose: Connects liquid water and the lower-density solid.

shots.intent: Finish tightly on the floating cube at the waterline; the tank and buoyancy cue are the complete payoff.

effects.purpose: Readable upward-support/buoyancy emphasis around the ice.
